authored_narrative.episode_purpose: Twelve episodes in, this Story keeps extending not toward a new conflict but simply further into the life it already found — motion through the world as its own justification, without needing to resolve into anything.

scene_spirited_away_dragon_flight_0057.purpose: A brief passage through open air, notable only for how unremarkable it is — the Story's twelfth scene, and among its plainest, which is itself a kind of achievement given how much weight early scenes carried.
scene_spirited_away_dragon_flight_0057.stakes: whether a Story this long can keep a reader without manufacturing new stakes
scene_spirited_away_dragon_flight_0057.opposing_force: none named — this episode continues the discipline of not inventing tension where none exists

scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0060.purpose: A memory-shaped space folds the bathhouse-arrival motif in one more time, at its quietest register yet — recognized, not dwelt on, filed away with everything else this Story has settled.
scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0060.stakes: whether a callback can still land meaningfully on its third real appearance
scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0060.opposing_force: the risk of diminishing returns, answered only by keeping the appearance brief rather than trying to make it bigger

shot_spirited_00449.intent: A short, functional traveling shot with no visual argument attached — motion recorded, not interpreted.

shot_spirited_00473.intent: A brief, unemphatic frame — the anchor's third real appearance gets the smallest visual treatment of the three, deliberately.
